method.score_to_weights: existing tail_weights with fractional allocation of tied boundaries
method.return_proxy: sum of weight times finite official forward label, no renormalization after missing labels
method.unknown_labels: unpriced contribution omitted and held-label mass explicitly reported; not assumed known zero return
method.daily_cost_notional: sum(abs(initial weights)) + sum intraday abs changes + sum(abs(final weights))
method.risk_ratio: mean / sample standard deviation of daily sums; no annualization
method.overnight_holdings: none; daily hypothetical reset to cash
